steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Ah.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text:
(quietly)
Well, at least it is standing.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Parts of it are standing. The rest appears to be negotiating terms with gravity.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: I have seen worse. Though not recently.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: The crown sent you.

options.text: Aye. Reinforcements. We should have come sooner.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: You came. That is more than most.

options.text: We'd heard the garrison was manned by one soldier. I did not believe it until now.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text:
(he looks down at the hammer on the stone)
It is the unfortunate truth.

options.text: Two of us were sent, and one joined in along the way.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text:
Three.
(he looks at the outpost behind him)
I suppose its better than none.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: I am {player_name}.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Tharr.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Fenwick. I trained as a wizard, but my true purpose has always been the kitchen. Please tell me there is a hearth.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Aye. There is a hearth.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Then there is a kitchen. You simply lacked someone to tell you so.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text:
Elara. I trade these routes.
(she glances past Tharr, toward a collapsed structure inside the walls)
Is that a trading post?

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: It was.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Hmm. Interesting.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Come inside.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: The walls need mending, the fields have gone to seed, and it seems the forest presses closer every season.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: But the foundation holds. I have seen to that.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: There is much work to be done here, if you are willing.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: We are willing.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Good.
